definitions.gloss: hardship; painfulness; how hard something is to bear
definitions.explanation: The quality of being emotionally or physically hard to bear, and the suffering that comes with it. The noun form of {辛|つら}い.

examples.japanese: ⟦{別|わか}れ→別れ：03788_wakare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{辛|つら}さ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耐|た}えた→耐える：12087_taeru⟧。
examples.english: I endured the pain of parting.
I couldn't tell anyone how hard the work was.

examples.japanese: ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{闘|たたか}う→闘う：17304_tatakau⟧{辛|つら}さ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧しか⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: Only those who have been through it understand how hard it is to fight an illness.

notes:
The noun form of ⟦{辛|つら}い→辛い：01112_tsurai⟧ (painful, hard to bear). Refers to emotional or physical hardship and the suffering it brings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {辛|つら}さ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耐|た}える→耐える：12087_taeru⟧: to endure hardship
- {辛|つら}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}える→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧: to overcome hardship
- ⟦{別|わか}れ→別れ：03788_wakare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{辛|つら}さ: the pain of parting

USAGE:
The same kanji {辛|から}さ read からさ means 'spiciness/hotness' — a completely different word.
